newsitem.title: GUYANA: CRICKET-HOOPER TAKES THREE WICKETS AS TEST HEADS TO DRAW.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HOOPER TAKES THREE WICKETS AS TEST HEADS TO DRAW.

text.p: Off-spinner Carl Hooper captured three wickets as India lost their last five wickets in the space of 75 runs on Monday on the final day of the fifth and final test against West Indies.
But it was all fairly meaningless as the rain-hit match ground towards a draw with India being dismissed for 355 in their first innings by tea on the final day.

It did, however, provide former India captain Mohammad Azharuddin the opportunity to complete 5,000 runs in test cricket. He reached the milestone in his 83rd test when he had scored 20, although he was out 11 runs later.
West Indies are 1-0 ahead in the five-match series.
